subject: Renewal upsell: Dedicated pool expansion — verification + operational handoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Dan Murray <dan.murray@oliveai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal upsell: Dedicated pool expansion — scheduling verification test

Hi Dan,

Congrats again on the renewal — excited to continue supporting Olive AI. Per the renewal paperwork we added +8 reserved GPUs to your Dedicated pool (going from 12 -> 20 A100-equivalent units), bumped baseline throughput to the "Sustained 24/7" SLA, and added burst capacity for traffic spikes. Before we mark the expansion complete we need to validate the configuration with a short set of acceptance tests and then do an ops handoff.

Proposed quick plan:
- Wed 2026-10-01 14:00 UTC: coordinated load run (our harness + your traffic replay)
- Targets: sustain 200k tokens/min with p95 token latency <= 140ms at 32-token responses, error rate < 0.5%
- Tests: steady-state 30m, 5x scaled ramp to simulate peak, KV cache warm and cold runs
- Deliverables: CSV of raw telemetry, summary report, ops runbook for on-call, signed acceptance email

I've attached a proposed test plan (rwd_proposed_test_plan_20261001.xlsx). Can you confirm Dan + infra availability? If you prefer a different window we can adjust.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

-----
Attachment: rwd_proposed_test_plan_20261001.xlsx (spreadsheet; test schedule, metrics list)
From: Dan Murray <dan.murray@oliveai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <contracts@oliveai.com>, Olive AI - Infra Team <infra@oliveai.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal upsell: Dedicated pool expansion — scheduling verification test

Thanks Karthik — Wed 14:00 UTC works for us. I'll have Infra on the call and we'll run a traffic replay from our staging traces. A couple clarifications:

1) When you say "200k tokens/min", is that measured at the Redwood ingress (post-routing) or at the model process (tokens produced)? We need to map to our billing meter.
2) Can you include a p99 latency snapshot in the report? Our internal SLOs are tight and p99 regressions would block sign-off.

I'll make sure contracts@ is looped for any final procurement notes after acceptance.

—Dan
Senior Infra Eng, Olive AI
dan.murray@oliveai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dan Murray <dan.murray@oliveai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal upsell: Dedicated pool expansion — scheduled load run results (summary)

Dan —

Thanks for running with us earlier. Summary from today's coordinated run (attached: olive_load_test_summary_20261001.csv). Highlights:

- Configuration validated: Dedicated pool increased to 20 A100-equivalents, model pinned to rwd-gpt-3.5-xded (int8 quantized variant)
- Steady-state (30m): average throughput 205,400 tokens/min; p95 latency = 128ms; p99 latency = 312ms
- Error rate: 0.22% (mostly transient socket timeouts during one 30s network blip)
- Burst ramp (5x): system sustained 920k tokens/min for 60s ramps without queue overflows; tail latencies increased to p99=680ms during bursts
- Cache behavior: warm-KV runs saw 9% lower per-token CPU on model hosts compared to cold runs

Deviations vs proposed acceptance: p95 < 140ms met; p99 is higher than you'd prefer (312ms steady, 680ms during burst). Our SRE team investigated and identified two mitigations we recommend before formal sign-off:
- Increase GPU worker prefetch concurrency by 12% (low risk, config change)
- Adjust instance-level network MTU on one affected AZ (fixes observed socket fragmentation)

We'll implement the config tweak now and re-run a short verification. Attaching raw CSV for your infra team to ingest.

Deliverables attached: olive_load_test_summary_20261001.csv

Cheers,
Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

-----
Attachment: olive_load_test_summary_20261001.csv (CSV; per-host telemetry: tokens/sec, latencies, errors)
From: Dan Murray <dan.murray@oliveai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olive AI - Infra Team <infra@oliveai.com>, Procurement <contracts@oliveai.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal upsell: Dedicated pool expansion — scheduled load run results (summary)

Appreciate the quick turnaround Marissa. Two questions before we proceed to sign-off:

1) For the p99 spikes to 680ms during burst — can you provide a breakdown by AZ and by host? We need to know if this is localized or systemic.
2) The error taxonomy: are the socket timeouts client side (our replay) or internal between routing and model workers? If internal, we need a post-mortem draft for our compliance team.

If the mitigations are low-risk and get p99 into a more reasonable band (<450ms steady-state, <1s during burst) we'll be comfortable signing acceptance and enabling the billing uptick.

—Dan

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Dan Murray <dan.murray@oliveai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal upsell: Dedicated pool expansion — SRE findings & ops handoff

Hi Dan —

Quick operational update after we implemented the recommended tweaks:

- Action 1: Increased GPU worker prefetch concurrency by 12%. Effect: p95 improved from 128ms -> 116ms; p99 steady reduced from 312ms -> 238ms. Burst p99 reduced from 680ms -> 510ms.
- Action 2: Network MTU fix applied to the affected AZ; verified socket fragmentation dropped to negligible levels. That eliminated most observed transient timeouts. Error rate now 0.08%.
- AZ breakdown (steady-state p99): AZ-1: 220ms, AZ-2: 260ms, AZ-3: 230ms. Burst peak p99 highest in AZ-2 historically due to host placement density.

Next steps for operational handoff:
- We've published an ops runbook (ops_runbook_dedicated_expansion_v1.pdf) covering: escalation matrix, targeted dashboards (per-route tokens/sec, per-host token latency histograms), automated remediation playbooks (restart worker, scale pool), and runbook commands.
- We created the following monitoring alerts in your tenant: p95 > 200ms sustained 5m, p99 > 600ms sustained 3m, errors > 0.5% 1m. Alerts post to your PagerDuty integration and to Redwood SRE on a 24/7 shared channel.
- We'll schedule a 30-minute knowledge transfer session for your on-call next Tue if that works.

For acceptance: please confirm by replying with a sign-off statement ("Olive AI accepts the dedicated expansion and signs off on operational runbook") and we'll mark the deal as Accepted and trigger the billing change. We can also prepare a short MOP (Method of Procedure) sign-off PDF for procurement to countersign.

I've attached the runbook and put a draft signed MOP in progress — we'll assemble the final signed_capacity_mop.pdf after you confirm.

—Sean
SRE Lead | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai

-----
Attachment: ops_runbook_dedicated_expansion_v1.pdf (PDF; runbook: dashboards, alerts, playbooks)
From: Dan Murray <dan.murray@oliveai.com>

Cc: Procurement <contracts@oliveai.com>, Olive AI - Infra Team <infra@oliveai.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance: Dedicated expansion and ops runbook

Sean / team —

Olive AI accepts the dedicated expansion and signs off on the operational runbook. The mitigations reduced the tail adequately for our needs: steady p99 = 238ms, burst p99 = 510ms; error rate 0.08% is acceptable. Please proceed to enable the reserved capacity billing adjustment per the renewal terms and provide the final signed MOP PDF for contracts to countersign.

Also: please enable autoscaling headroom for the first 30 days (allow +15% burst capacity) and schedule the runbook knowledge transfer for next Tue 10:00 UTC. Procurement — we'll countersign after the final MOP is uploaded.

Thanks for the quick collaboration.
—Dan
Senior Infra Eng, Olive AI
dan.murray@oliveai.com
